Personality: Nonna, a prominent figure of the Venicones, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Nonna owes allegiance to the Caledonian Clans, hailing from the noble house of Venicones. Historical Record: Wife of Unust, head of the Venicones, a Pretanic house of Caledonia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
